description: Exports the current drawing to a standard AutoCAD 2000 (AC1015) ASCII DXF file compatible with AutoCAD, Civil 3D, SolidWorks, and LibreCAD.

filePath.description: Path of the .dxf file inside the output folder (CAD_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR, default: the server working directory), e.g. "plans/level1.dxf"

name: cad_export_dxf
